nodes.description: Ownable.owner: address of the contract owner, set from msg.sender in constructor and used by onlyOwner checks.
Pausable.paused: boolean emergency stop flag controlling whenNotPaused/whenPaused modifiers.
CCCRSale.investWallet: address receiving all ether collected by the sale.
CCCRSale.tokenReward: CCCRCoin token contract used for reward transfers.
CCCRSale.tokenPrice: base price constant used by getRate, mutable by owner via updatePrice.
CCCRSale.zeroAmount: divisor (1e10) applied to incoming wei amount.
CCCRSale.startline: ICO start timestamp used for time-based rate tiers.
CCCRSale.minCap: minimum total raised threshold that triggers pausing.
CCCRSale.totalRaised: running total of tokens sold.
SafeMath.mul: checked multiplication with overflow assertion.
SafeMath.div: integer division.
SafeMath.sub: checked subtraction with underflow assertion.
SafeMath.add: checked addition with overflow assertion.
Ownable constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender.
Ownable.transferOwnership: owner-only ownership handover.
Pausable.pause: owner-only function that sets paused = true.
Pausable.unpause: owner-only function that sets paused = false.
CCCRSale constructor: stores the reward token contract address.
CCCRSale fallback: payable entry point that forwards msg.sender and msg.value to buy.
CCCRSale.getRate: returns a time-dependent price multiplier based on block.timestamp.
CCCRSale.buy: computes tokens, transfers rewards to buyer, forwards ether to investWallet and updates totalRaised.
CCCRSale.updatePrice: owner-only setter for tokenPrice.
CCCRSale.transferTokens: owner-only withdrawal of reward tokens to the owner.
CCCRSale.airdrop: owner-only loop distributing tokens to an array of addresses.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller address used for ownership checks and buy().
block.timestamp: miner-influenceable time value driving rate tiers in getRate.
External call tokenReward.transfer(buyer, tokens) inside buy: invokes an untrusted contract before state/ether settlement.
External call investWallet.transfer(this.balance) inside buy: sends full balance to an address and can hand control to a contract receiver.
External call tokenReward.transfer(owner, _tokens) inside transferTokens.
External call tokenReward.transfer(arrayAddress[i], arrayAmount[i]) inside the airdrop loop.
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership.
buyer parameter of buy, receiving the purchased tokens.
_amount parameter of buy, the wei value used to compute tokens.
_tokenPrice parameter of updatePrice.
_tokens parameter of transferTokens.
_array1 parameter of airdrop (recipient addresses).
_array2 parameter of airdrop (token amounts).
_tokenReward parameter of the CCCRSale constructor.
Local amount in buy: _amount divided by zeroAmount.
Local tokens in buy: amount multiplied by getRate().
Local arrayAddress in airdrop: memory copy of _array1.
Local arrayAmount in airdrop: memory copy of _array2.
Local arrayLength in airdrop: array length minus one, loop bound.
Local i in airdrop: loop counter.
Local c in SafeMath.mul: product a * b.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned as the owner in the Ownable constructor, establishing the privileged account.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner, which compares msg.sender against owner.
newOwner parameter is validated (non-zero) and written into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the new owner address into state, changing the authorization set.
pause is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier using msg.sender.
unpause is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier using msg.sender.
pause sets the paused state variable to true.
unpause resets the paused state variable to false.
whenNotPaused modifier reads paused to gate execution of pause.
whenPaused modifier reads paused to gate execution of unpause.
Fallback function forwards msg.sender as the buyer argument.
Fallback function directly invokes buy(msg.sender, msg.value).
msg.sender reaches buy as the buyer address receiving tokens.
buyer parameter is checked against address(0) and used as token recipient.
_amount parameter is divided by zeroAmount to derive the token amount.
zeroAmount state variable scales the incoming amount inside buy.
Local amount is computed and used to derive tokens within buy.
Local tokens is the value transferred to the buyer and added to totalRaised.
buy calls getRate() to obtain the multiplier for token computation.
getRate branches on block.timestamp, making the sale price miner-influenceable.
startline state variable anchors the timestamp tiers in getRate.
tokenPrice state variable is multiplied by tier multipliers in getRate.
getRate uses SafeMath.mul for the tiered price computation.
getRate uses SafeMath.div to normalize the multiplier.
tokenReward state variable is the target contract of the external transfer in buy.
Local tokens is the amount passed to tokenReward.transfer inside buy.
Local amount feeds the token quantity sent by the external transfer.
buyer parameter is the receiver argument of tokenReward.transfer.
buy performs an external token transfer before forwarding ether to investWallet, leaving an interleaving window.
investWallet state variable is the destination of the ether transfer in buy.
totalRaised is updated after the external transfer of this.balance, so state lags behind external calls.
buy reads and adds to totalRaised via SafeMath.
buy uses SafeMath.add for the totalRaised accumulation; overflow would revert, so the operation is guarded.
buy sets paused = true when totalRaised reaches or exceeds minCap.
minCap state variable is compared against totalRaised before pausing the sale.
whenNotPaused modifier reads paused to gate execution of buy.
_tokenPrice parameter is assigned into the tokenPrice state variable.
updatePrice is owner-only and mutates the price used by all purchases.
updatePrice relies on msg.sender via the onlyOwner modifier.
transferTokens relies on msg.sender via the onlyOwner modifier.
_tokens parameter is the amount sent by transferTokens.
transferTokens sends reward tokens to the privileged owner address.
tokenReward state variable is the target contract of the external transfer in transferTokens.
_tokens parameter flows into the external token transfer call.
airdrop relies on msg.sender via the onlyOwner modifier.
_array1 parameter is copied into the local arrayAddress.
_array2 parameter is copied into the local arrayAmount.
Local arrayAddress supplies recipient addresses in the airdrop loop.
Local arrayAmount supplies token amounts in the airdrop loop.
arrayAddress[i] is the receiver of the external token transfer in airdrop.
arrayAmount[i] is the amount of the external token transfer in airdrop.
tokenReward state variable is the called contract in the airdrop transfer loop.
arrayLength is derived from the length of _array1 using SafeMath.sub(1); an empty array would underflow and revert.
SafeMath.sub computes arrayLength = arrayAddress.length - 1.
arrayLength bounds the while loop controlling local i.
Local i is the loop index used to iterate the airdrop transfers.
Loop counter i indexes the arrays passed to tokenReward.transfer.
SafeMath.add increments the loop counter i, preventing unbounded wrap.
Local c = a * b in SafeMath.mul; the raw multiplication is asserted afterwards for overflow.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter newOwner only exists to feed transferOwnership and should be folded into that function node.
Parameter buyer is consumed solely inside buy and is normalized into it.
Parameter _amount is consumed solely inside buy and is normalized into it.
Parameter _tokenPrice exists only to update tokenPrice via updatePrice.
Parameter _tokens is only used by transferTokens and its external call.
Parameter _array1 is only consumed by the airdrop loop.
Parameter _array2 is only consumed by the airdrop loop.
Constructor parameter _tokenReward is only used to initialize the tokenReward state variable.
Local amount is an intermediate computation exclusive to buy.
Local tokens is the argument of the external token transfer inside buy and is folded into that unsafe operation.
Local arrayAddress is a memory alias used only within airdrop.
Local arrayAmount is a memory alias used only within airdrop.
Local arrayLength is the loop bound computed inside airdrop.
Local i is the iteration counter of the airdrop loop.
Local c is the intermediate product inside SafeMath.mul and is folded into that function.
